CVX Venture Scout Programme 

 Do you have a passion for sourcing investments and making a difference for growth companies? Do you want to assist an extraordinary team of talented, motivated, driven individuals who all share a deep passion for entrepreneurship? If so, you may be our new Venture Scout. Please note, this is not a full time role, but we will provide remuneration based on success criteria. 

 Introduction 

 The CVX Venture Scout Programme is building a network of highly talented VC scouts, to assist us in sourcing attractive investment opportunities, in their specialist fields. You will learn and develop some of the most important skills required to be in VC, and meet with some of the most interesting and entrepreneurial founders in your market, and help shape the future.

 As part of your role as a CVX Venture Scout, the Investment Team will look to you to identify exciting startups, speak with them and conduct research on them, including their teams, markets, and competition. Based on your findings, you will write a 1-2 page proposal memo summarising your investment thesis, and may be asked to present it in-person or online to the CVX Investment Team.

 Expectations 

 We aim to use our Venture Scout Programme not only to discover exceptional investment opportunities but also to gain a deeper understanding of you and your vision. If you are interested in joining the CVX Investment Team, this is an excellent first step towards not only gaining an introduction to the VC ecosystem and learning essential VC skills, but also demonstrating how you think about investments, analyse them, and present your insights to us. As we grow our Investment Team, the Venture Scout Programme will be the first pool of resource we look to hire from.

 Compensation 

 We want to remunerate good work and give credit to your role in the investment process, where successful. We will therefore compensate you when a deal that you take forward to the investment team receives funding from our network of investors, with an opportunity for you to benefit from the upside too.

 Our Mission 

 CVX is one of Europe's fastest-growing venture investors, and we help ambitious and promising growth companies reach their full potential by investing capital, knowledge, time, skills, and network. We are driven by our conviction that the best investors are often those who, in addition to capital, provide founders with the right knowledge and experiences, skills, and networks in relation to the stage and industry in which the company operates. CVX always invests together with the best business angels for the respective founder, and today we have over 700 partners in our network who invest in companies and bring their skills into play where they can really add value.

ABOUT BIP CAPITAL 
 BIP Capital is an integrated private market investment platform built to create and capture opportunities through BIP Ventures traditional venture anchor funds, an Evergreen equity BDC, and private credit offerings. With a distinctive multi-stage, multi-sector investment approach and a growing array of capital offerings, BIP Capital has generated consistent top quartile returns since 2009.
 ABOUT BIP VENTURES 
 BIP Ventures, the North American-focused venture capital division of BIP Capital, is a highly active venture capital firm based in the Southeast. BIP Ventures partners with extraordinary founders to drive exceptional outcomes. Since 2007, BIP Ventures has invested in the success of B2B software and tech-enabled service businesses at all stages of maturity. In addition to capital, it supports entrepreneurs with access to infrastructure, acumen, and talent, resulting in category-leading companies.
 OUR PHILOSOPHY 
 We are champions of our investors' goals and stewards of founders' dreams, but more than that, we are ethical, honest partners who serve, educate, and protect our founders and investors. We take on the challenges and complex conversations because we operate out of integrity and genuine care.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for an enthusiastic, growth-oriented Associate Product Owner to join our team and contribute to the development of BIP's innovative technology products. This is a support-focused, execution-oriented role, an excellent opportunity for a motivated early-career product professional who is eager to learn, comfortable with shifting priorities, and ready to grow within a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
 As an Associate Product Owner at BIP, you will work hands-on with our core technology platforms, including our internal CRM and fund management platform, our external investor portal, and our external advisor portal, supporting backlog management, writing user stories and release notes, managing our Jira Service Desk, performing QA, and collaborating closely with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders. We're looking for someone with strong interpersonal skills who can build rapport with engineers, communicate clearly under ambiguity, and avoid analysis paralysis when priorities shift. The ideal candidate brings curiosity, decisiveness, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex domain, including finance and venture capital concepts.
 LOCATION: Hybrid with ability to be on-site when required out of Buckhead / Atlanta Office.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 • Backlog Support: Assist in maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog under the guidance of senior team members, ensuring the team is focused on delivering high-value work.
• User Story & Release Note Writing: Write and refine clear, concise user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria; draft release notes to communicate product updates to stakeholders.
• Jira Service Desk Management: Own day-to-day triage and resolution of service desk requests, maintaining a 24–48-hour SLA for responses and escalating as appropriate.
• Sprint Participation: Actively participate in grooming and sprint planning sessions; support efforts to keep the backlog 1–2 sprints ahead with 'ready' work.
• QA & Feature Validation: Perform acceptance testing and quality assurance on user stories to ensure features meet requirements and are free of critical defects before release.
• Small-to-Medium Feature Delivery: Take ownership of small and medium-sized features end-to-end, from writing epics and stories as directed through to release.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a day-to-day liaison between engineering and business stakeholders; build strong working relationships, keep communication clear
• Multi-System Requirements Management: Manage requirements across at least three different systems, ensuring they are clear, traceable, and aligned across stakeholders and workstreams.
• Feedback Collection: Participate in sprint reviews, gather and document stakeholder feedback to continuously improve the product and inform backlog prioritization.
• Documentation: Support the creation of process flows, user guides, and internal documentation as needed.
 Requirements 
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 • Experience: 1 to 3 years of experience in product development, project coordination, or working within Agile/Scrum teams, specifically with software, platform, or web-based products. Experience in a related analytical or technology role will also be considered. 
• Technical Acumen: Jira is the primary tool; Confluence is a plus. Experience with Rally or equivalent Agile platforms is acceptable. Basic familiarity with the software development lifecycle is expected.
• AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms, for prototyping, design exploration, or accelerating product workflows. Comfort applying AI tools practically in a product context is expected.
• Domain Comfort: Comfortable working within complex domains, including finance or venture capital concepts. You don't need to arrive as an expert, but you must be willing and able to learn quickly.
• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey ideas clearly to engineers, stakeholders, and teammates. 
• People Skills: Friendly, curious, and emotionally intelligent. You build rapport easily, especially with engineers, adapt to various personalities and bring energy that improves team dynamics.
• Self-Starter Mentality: You take initiative, ask questions to fill knowledge gaps, and demonstrate resourcefulness. 
• Resilience & Adaptability: Comfortable operating within shifting priorities and frequent pivots. Open to feedback and quick to adapt to you, you see ambiguity as a normal part of a fast-paced environment.
• Analytical Skills: Ability to gather and interpret information to support product decisions and backlog prioritization. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are prioritized over deep analytics.
• Education: A bachelor's degree in business, computer science, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent work experience is welcomed.
 SUCCESS METRICS 
 • At 90 Days: Demonstrate foundational knowledge of our core product platforms and other internal systems, and team workflows. Build positive working relationships with key stakeholders by supporting sprint ceremonies, triaging Jira Service Desk requests within the 24–48-hour SLA and contributing well-written user stories. Maintain a backlog with 1–2 sprints of groomed, ready work.
• At Six Months: Independently triage and resolve 90% of service desk requests within SLA. Contribute consistently to sprint ceremonies and maintain backlog management 3–4 sprints ahead. Take ownership of at least one small project end-to-end, delivering quality work from user story through release. Maintain accurate Jira documentation and actively support stakeholder feedback loops.
• At One Year: Demonstrate readiness to independently manage the backlog and own 1–2 active medium projects end-to-end. Begin contributing strategic insights to product decisions. Become a reliable resource across our core platforms, contribute to internal documentation, and show clear progress toward full Product Owner-level responsibilities.
 Benefits 
 WHY JOIN US 
 • Join a lean, agile team of startup-minded professionals who take ownership, move fast, and deliver high-quality, impactful products.
• Contribute to meaningful, innovative solutions, including our suite of internal and external platforms, that power the operations of a dynamic venture capital firm and its portfolio.
• Build and expand your product management expertise in an environment that values curiosity, autonomy, and continuous learning.
• Collaborate with smart, driven teammates who challenge each other to think bigger, move smarter, and constantly improve.
• Grow into a Product Owner or broader leadership role as we scale; your impact will be seen and valued every step of the way.
 WHY JOIN BIP CAPITA L
 • Top-quartile Performance: We are a leading venture capital firm in a vibrant tech ecosystem offering national prominence.
• Internal Growth: We foster critical thinking and promote internal advancement from day one.
• Unique Value Proposition: Our firm boasts a robust, defensible value proposition supported by a high-net-worth investor base.
• Merit-based Environment: We encourage you to bet on yourself, leveraging your merit to excel and thrive.
• Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salaries, health and wellness plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.
 BIP Capital is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics. BIP Capital is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
